traps.quote: declares the access rules on the servlet itself, instead of listing them in the deployment descriptor
traps.note: Impact paragraph spells out the servlet-level-annotation, programmatic-registration surface (no ServletSecurity/createServlet identifier); registration clause widens past descriptor-declared servlets.
Registration-mechanism widening singles out the non-descriptor/embedded path where the authenticator is never installed, without naming the valve, startup phase or embedded launcher.
Path widening and 'one example, not the whole set' point at path/mapping reachability; the addMapping-after-rules timing is never spelled out.
